_why: NIGHT38 builder E (NIGHT38.md E1, PLAN.md 2): every verb and combo's reach, MEASURED on the real sim by `dotnet run --project Tools/SimHarness -c Release -- n38 envelopes --write` (a Survival run's SurvivalSim, the config's movement rows, the real Loadout's THUNDERCLAP shot; the Mover's World a box world). Not a level file: level builders space gates from it, and `n38 gates <plan>` proves each gate in its own geometry. Rerun after any movement or weapon tuning.
ground_why: From standing ground: the run-up sprint held (12 m), the verb at the lip of a 40 m ledge over a void. reach = metres along the run past the lip while the feet are still at or above the takeoff height (the gap a same-height landing can be); reach2m = the same 2 m under it (a landing 2 m lower); apex = the most the feet rose over the takeoff. best = the try (timing, pitch) that reached farthest; apexBest = the highest. Boost tries look back along the run and down (pitch deg) so the shot's push (-aim x jumpSpeed) goes forward and up; xN = N shots chained at the gun's own fire interval.
ride_why: From a wall ride: a held ride on a long wall, released 0.5 s in at look pitch -45 / 0 / +45 deg (the jump-off), then nothing / the double jump 0.25 s later / a dash 0.15 s later / one or two THUNDERCLAP shots (looking back down 45 deg) from 0.1 s later. out = metres out from the release point perpendicular to the wall while the feet are at or above the release height; along = metres along the wall; apex = over the release point.
facingGaps_why: Plane gaps (m, 3..20) between two facing walls where a held ride on the first, released with 3 m of it left (pitch 0, the stick away) and the jump pressed again 0.25 s later, starts a ride on the second (the flight room's ride chain). A gap past the last one listed needs more than a ride chain.
shaft_why: Metres climbed in 4 s between two parallel walls 3 m / 5 m apart with tap wall jumps (pressed and held 0.1 s on each new wall contact).
grapple_why: READ from design.n32.grapple32 / design.n35.grapple35, not flown (the hook aims through the sim's own GameWorld). Under grapple35 the hook pulls you to whatever surface it hits within range: the gate checker counts a gate as grappled when a point of its landing solid within 1 m of the top is in line of sight within range from the takeoff eye (or a grapple node is).
shockwave_why: READ: the THUNDERCLAP's LT self push (design.shockwave.selfPush via Mover.Impulse) is live only while design.n25.shockwaveOff is off (Loadout.ShockwaveOn); off, no level owns it.
